reviews.x: Good product for the price! Very easy to take in and out and a very nice variety of colors. I'm actually fairly surprised by the fact that these are just as good of a quality as the ones I get from my local piercing store...and those are $20-40 EACH! Great deal, would certainly recommend. They are a little smaller than you may want though, but they still fit okay.

These are a great deal.  I can't speak to the quality of the items, but at this  price I don't expect then to be.  I got 40 nose studs for what I'd pay for one at the stores locally.  They are exactly what I wanted and true to what was advertised.  The shipping was ahead of schedule.  No problems or complaints.  I would buy again from this seller.

reviews.t: Love them! They are comfy not to big and ...
reviews.x: Love them! They are comfy not to big and arejust right.  They sit nicely even though my face isn't doing justice. It was worth the money and I have a place to store my other ones! Thanks again
love them, they came one month earlier than expected. They came in the perfect condition. The colours are just beautiful! x

reviews.t: For the price, and how many studs you get this is good.
reviews.x: I did enjoy this. The only problem I had was that it was 22g instead of 20g, but it's alright. I did like how they looked, and the colors are vibrant. I do like that there is 5 of each color just in case I lose one since they are very small. Very good price for the product. Shipping took less time than expected and I enjoyed this product. I would recommend it to anyone who just had their nose pierced since the 22g don't hurt as much to put in as the 20g do.

It works really well and perfect for what you are going for, i do prefer sterling silver but these are cool too no problem so far, the stone is really small and cute! I have a 20g piercing and these are a 22 (im guessing) or smaller but they still work well If your nose is 22, 20, i think you should be perfect if you are 18g that is a lot bigger but it still may work for you because i have some 18g rings and well, they stretch my hole wider but nothing too crazy. Overall it took 2 full weeks to

reviews.t: Best Quality, Variety, and Price of Noserings You Can Find!!
reviews.x: Anyone with a nose piercing knows how easy it is to lose them. Mine tend to get stuck on my towel when I'm drying my face after a shower, or it gets caught on my blanket at night and I can never, ever find it. Sometimes, I blow my nose and don't realize that it came out in the tissue and gets thrown away. The low price and large assortment of these nose rings CANNOT be beat. None of the stones have come out, they haven't tarnished, or bent. Surprisingly, I haven't lost any of them, either. They

reviews.t: they are what they seem to be
reviews.x: I'm not sure what more can be said.  I needed a lot of nose studs for cheap and that is what I got.  So far none of the crystals (or whatever they are) have fallen out, so that's good.  Shipping to longer then I would like, but that was expected.

Awesome price for these! I'm really bad about losing my nose ring in the shower or while toweling off, so this pack is super great! I bought these back months ago and I still have a bunch. No irritation, stay put & comfortable and colors are pretty close to what they displayed on my monitor when I bought them. Only downside is these things ship from China (which I initially didn't realize) and took a little longer than expected to get here, but still definitely worth buying.

reviews.t: Im inlove with these nose rings
reviews.x: I lose nose rings left and right and to buy just one at a smoke shop is like 3 bucks a piece or more so to get all.of these for the price is a steal. I love them. I have really sensitive skin as well and they don't bother me at all

18g for anyone wondering! If you have just recently gotten your nose pierced I don't recomend these. These are for those of us who have had it pierced for a awhile and it's gotten a bit stretched. It hurt just a smidge to put it in but to me that is great because that means it won't fall out! Recieved my item extremely fast! Ordered on Friday night and it's 11AM Sunday and they were just delivered! Unbeatable price and the quality is not lacking either. Thank you!

reviews.t: This is the best deal on nose rings I've found
reviews.x: This is the best deal on nose rings I've found. I got this for a gift awhile ago, and the person has only lost two rings the whole time they've had it. They stay in really well; a lot better than any other rings used.
cute, fits, works, stays in place, many colors as show, no irritation. cheap! thanks amazon!

reviews.t: Color is wonderful...looks more like a regular earring than nose stud, falls out
reviews.x: Colors are beautiful!!! I only gave 3 stars because the stone sits up too high (almost looks like i put a regular earring in my nose)...last nose studs i had sat perfectly on my nose.  Also, these nose studs will fall out very, very easily.  I have had my nose pierced for almost 20 years and I bought these for the red. I will probably never wear them as I don't feel safe stud will stay in.  Disagree with another review that gauge is too thick, actually quite thin and ball does nothing to stop it

reviews.t: Great! So many for so little.
reviews.x: When I opened the package and saw how small these were, I thought there was no way they would even go all the way through my nose; but they do! And they stay in all day without causing any irritation. The size of the gem is perfect- it is not so small that it is barely noticeable and it is not so large that it looks like a pimple on your nose (as some do). I can't believe how much money I saved myself by buying these online instead of at Hot Topic or Spencer's ($13 for 4 nose bones? no thank you

The nose studs themselves are awesome for the price. They are small stones, and obviously bones, so its nice to have a surplus of them for when they fall out (Not very often, but it happens). The one thing that really affected how many stars i gave this product, is that I was under the impression I'd be getting 5 studs of each color; however, thats not the case. Over 50% of the studs I received were yellow-which I would never wear. Basically the good colors, like blue, green and white are scarce

I LOVE my nose rings! they fit perfectly, don't hit the inside of my nose, no defects or anything, they came almost a month early, I have 8 different colors to be able to wear with different outfits, I've had them almost a month now and haven't lost one in my sleep at all, (im accident prone to loosing them in my sleep lol) I would highly recommend them to anybody looking to buy in bulk instead of 3 for 10 dollars at any other store! I will definitely be shopping from these guys again!! :) Next

reviews.t: great deal for the price, worth the wait!
reviews.x: I bought these for my tragus because they were so nice and small. Great deal for the price, though I did end up with 13 clear ones that I will probably never use. It still gets four stars from me though since they were so cheap, came in a convenient case, and all of the gems were attached to the studs. Just be sure to leave yourself plenty of time to get them in before you actually need them because it does take them a little bit to get to you :)

reviews.t: My product packaging arrived ripped and the seller did not ...
reviews.x: My product packaging arrived ripped and the seller did not respond to comments. It has very little selection as far as colors, mostly pink and clear. Also, the jewels were sloppily applied and some are not sitting in the cup. I'll post pics when I find my camera charger. Oddly, this one seems to pop out of my nose more than my last ones from hot topic, but i'm really not sure why; they are sized as expected.

I ordered these thinking they would be average gauge, since I could not find anywhere on there that said the size. I was very disappointed. Normally I wear between an 18 and a 20g. I couldn't even wear them. They would not stay in because of how small they were. I gave it two stars because other than that the studs were exactly as expected. Vibrant colors and received on time.

reviews.t: Its painful to put in and makes my nose red
reviews.x: Its painful to put in and makes my nose red. It may be just me but after wearing this my nose hurts and turns red. To put it in you have to push hard till you bleed. The nose stud falls out a lot and pushing it in all the time gets annoying. Some of the studs are deformed other than that it could be worse. Only buy if you have a tough nose and are not pron to bleeding.

I'm a wild sleeper and surprisingly, I've not lost one of these studs yet. While these are small, I'm still able to find them either in my bed or nearby on the floor. Even if I couldn't find them immediately, I could simply replace them with another because so many come in the tray. I have had a couple of the gems to fall out but I was expecting that so no big deal.

I love these studs! They are tiny and sparkly...not too much. The price was GREAT for 40! The nose stud I had previously was always turning and you could see the post. These don't do that and stay in well. With all the colors, I can change it out to match my outfits. If I happen to lose one...no big deal...the price makes this not a problem.

I have very sensitive skin and have had to throw out more than a few earrings and nose rings. But these have caused no reaction of any kind. This is what I used as my first nose ring when I pierced my nose and they are comfortable, the stones are staying in place, and it looks good. At about $0.17 each this is a great option.

reviews.t: Cute Noserings for an Affordable Price
reviews.x: I love these little things! They are so cute, and being able to choose from a bunch of different colors makes putting in the nose ring exciting! The downside of this product is that the nose rings are very small, so you have to be careful not to sleep with them, or else they fall off and enter into a wrong hole in the body.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value, noting you get many studs for a very low price compared to buying individually.
Many customers say the studs stay in well and are comfortable without irritation.
Several reviewers appreciate the variety of colors and find them vibrant and as shown.
Some reviewers note the studs are smaller or a different gauge than expected, though many still find they work well.
A few reviewers mention the studs can fall out easily or sit too high, though this is less common.
